BLAST databases of the NCBI

Source: R/databases.R
ncbi_blast_dbs.Rd

list_ncbi_blast_dbs() lists the preformatted BLAST databases the NCBI publishes (https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/blast/db/), with their size and date. download_blast_db() downloads one of them (e.g. "core_nt", "16S_ribosomal_RNA", "ITS_eukaryote_sequences"), checks the md5 of each file, unpacks it and returns the path to give to parallel_blast().

The database goes to <dir>/<db>_<date>/ (the NCBI date of the database), so a newer release does not overwrite the one older results were searched against. An interrupted download is resumed: files already unpacked (with a matching md5) are not downloaded again. With taxonomy = TRUE, the taxonomy database of get_tax() matching the date of the BLAST database is built too, so the identifications can be made offline.

core_nt has about 300 GB unpacked (and is downloaded in volumes of a few GB, unpacked one at a time); see list_ncbi_blast_dbs() for the sizes.

Usage

list_ncbi_blast_dbs()

download_blast_db(
  db = "core_nt",
  dir,
  taxdb = TRUE,
  taxonomy = TRUE,
  keep_archives = FALSE,
  check_space = TRUE
)

Arguments

db

Name of the database, as in list_ncbi_blast_dbs()$db.

dir

Directory where the database directory is created.

taxdb

Also download taxdb (scientific names of the taxids, used by BLAST in sscinames) into the same directory.

taxonomy

Build the local taxonomy database of get_tax() for the date of this database (kept in the BLASTr cache).

keep_archives

Keep the .tar.gz files after unpacking.

check_space

Stop when the disk does not have room for the unpacked database plus one archive.

Value

list_ncbi_blast_dbs(): a tibble with db, type ("nucl"/"prot"), description, n_seqs, n_letters, n_volumes, size_gb (unpacked), download_gb and last_updated. download_blast_db(): the path of the database (directory and name, as db_path of parallel_blast()), invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
list_ncbi_blast_dbs()
db <- download_blast_db("16S_ribosomal_RNA", dir = "/data/databases")
parallel_blast(seqs, db_path = db, total_cores = 8)
} # }
